claims.sourceText: Gerald R. Ford, Statement on Signing the Bill Providing for the Relief of the Survivors of Dr. Frank R. Olson, 12 October 1976, https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/statement-signing-the-bill-providing-for-the-relief-the-survivors-dr-frank-r-olson
claims.text: President Ford signed the bill on 12 October 1976 and stated the administration's own position on the amount: 'Legislation to appropriate $1,250,000 to compensate the wife and three children of Dr. Olson for his death was supported by this administration. However, the Congress approved a measure calling for the payment of a total of $750,000 to these survivors.'

edges.label: Signed Private Law 94-126, 12 October 1976
edges.note: Ford signed S. 3035 paying the widow and three children $187,500 each in full settlement, and said his administration had supported $1,250,000 and would support further relief legislation.
